title: Installing the OS
summary: From firmware to ONLINE: flashing agentd on the ESP32-S3, pairing with a claim code, and joining your fleet.

head: Piece
Detail
rows: agentd + os-ui (no_std Rust, UI shared with the panel)
Your ecosystem email and password (this same account)
Board and your phone/PC on the same network to pair

items: Download your fleet's firmware (or build it from firmware/ with cargo).
Connect the board over USB and flash with Espressif's official tool.
On boot you'll see the NomikOS logo and, if it's new, a claim code on screen.
If the screen shows the clock and the dock, the OS is running.

blocks.title: Don't power off mid-flash
blocks.text: Interrupting the write can leave the board unbootable: repeat the full flash if it happens.

items: In the panel, open Fleet in the navbar.
Choose pair and enter the claim code shown on the AMOLED.
The device goes ONLINE inside YOUR account: taps, voice and tolls are tied to it.
Try it in the browser sandbox before going to production.
